tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all currently open projects in the IDE.

tools.name: get_supported_languages
tools.description: Get supported languages and diagnostics, implementations, incoming/outgoing capability states without starting language servers.

projectPath.description: Optional project root for current capability state

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Find symbol (class, function, variable) definition by name.

language.description: Optional: limit search to specific language

projectPath.description: Optional: project root path. Uses active project if not provided.

includeLibraries.description: Optional: include symbols from project dependencies/libraries (default: false)

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find all references to the symbol at the given location.

includeLibraries.description: Optional: include references from project dependencies/libraries (default: false)

tools.name: get_symbol_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about the symbol at the given location.

tools.name: get_file_symbols
tools.description: List all symbols in a file. Supported extensions: .swift, .cs, .py, .pyi, .java, .kt, .kts, .js, .mjs, .cjs, .ts, .mts, .cts, .jsx, .tsx, .vue, .php, .phtml, .rs, .go, .dart

tools.name: get_type_hierarchy
tools.description: Get the type hierarchy (base types and subtypes) for a class/interface.

language.description: Optional: specify language if type name is ambiguous

includeLibraries.description: Optional: include types from project dependencies/libraries (default: false)

tools.name: list_run_configurations
tools.description: List all run configurations defined in the IDE project (tests, applications, etc.).

projectPath.description: Optional: project root path. Uses active project if not provided.

tools.name: run_configuration
tools.description: Execute a run configuration by name and wait for it to complete. Use list_run_configurations to discover available configurations. Returns an executionId that can be used with get_test_results.

name.description: Name of the run configuration to execute

tools.name: get_test_results
tools.description: Get structured test results from a test execution. Returns test names, pass/fail status, duration, failure messages, and stack traces. Use after run_configuration to inspect test outcomes.

executionId.description: Optional: execution ID from run_configuration. Uses latest execution if not provided.

includeOutput.description: Optional: include stdout/stderr for each test (default: false)

failedOnly.description: Optional: only return failed tests (default: false)

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.description: Analyze specified files with enabled IDE inspections or language server. Per-file status distinguishes clean results from incomplete analysis.

tools.name: find_implementations
tools.description: Find IDE/LSP implementations and overrides at a declaration or usage. Excludes the target and deduplicates declarations; includes analysis status and truncation.

filePath.description: Absolute file path; unsaved IDE content takes precedence
